fish.reedling: A quick little river fish that bites all year, and the first catch most new anglers make.
fish.brookslip: A spring fish of the shallows that darts away from the bait the moment it feels a tug.
fish.millrun: Runs up the river in summer and likes the warm shallows near the mill.
fish.ferrywhisker: A whiskered bottom feeder that lurks near the old ferry landing in autumn, day or night.
fish.salmon: The big autumn run. Salmon fight hard and sell well, and the Stream Fish bundle asks for them.
fish.hearthside-dace: Rises at dusk all year, when the lamps in the valley come on.
fish.tallow-eel: A pale, slippery eel that only bites on winter nights, down near the river bed.
fish.silverthread: A flash of silver at first light. Rare, and quick to slip the line.
fish.old-mossback: An old fish with a mossy back that stirs on rainy autumn days. It sinks and then pulls.
fish.carp: The steady fish of the forest lake. It bites in daylight in every season.
fish.perch: A spring perch, easy enough to land with a decent rod.
fish.fernfin: Named for its green, frilled fins. It comes to the forest lake in summer.
fish.mushroom-loach: A dusk-time loach of the forest lake in autumn, found near the damp, mushroomy banks.
fish.moonmirror: Rises on any night, when the forest lake is flat and still.
fish.hermit-trout: A shy trout that only shows itself while it rains.
fish.marshlight: A pale fish of the delta marsh lake that drifts about in the daytime.
fish.bogwhisker: A darting fish of the marsh lake in spring and summer.
fish.sunk-boot-loach: Often hooked when an angler expected something grander. It bites at any hour.
fish.reed-cat: A night-time fish of the reeds that keeps low and moves slowly.
fish.catfish: A dusk fish of the marsh lake. It sinks, and rarely gives up quickly.
fish.bullhead: A grumpy bottom fish that bites in the marsh lake when it rains.
fish.glassy-elver: A see-through young eel of the marsh lake, caught at dawn in spring.
fish.sardine: A small silver fish found along the coast in daylight, all year.
fish.skiff-sprat: A tiny fish that gathers around the boats at the Beach every day of the year.
fish.mackerel: A fast, smooth swimmer of the Beach in summer and autumn.
fish.mullet: Comes to the shallows at dawn in spring.
fish.cod: The winter staple of the coast, caught in daylight.
fish.kelp-ribbon: A long, ribbon-like fish that floats among the kelp at dusk.
fish.harbour-ray: A flat ray that glides into the Beach shallows in summer.
fish.herring: Silver shoals come in at night all year round.
fish.lantern-squid: A glowing squid of autumn and winter nights. It rises, then drifts.
fish.crowned-tunny: A rare, fast-swimming tunny that visits the sea in summer and autumn, by day.
fish.cold-quill: A spiny little fish of the mountain lake, found by day in every season.
fish.arctic-char: Likes the cold: winter and spring in the mountain lake.
fish.granite-gudgeon: A grey fish of the rocky bottom, caught at any hour of the day or night.
fish.echo-pike: A pike that strikes when rain rings across the mountain lake.
fish.ember-trout: A trout with an orange belly, seen at dusk on summer evenings.
fish.glacier-ghost: A pale giant that drifts through the mountain lake on winter nights. Rare.
fish.pearlback: A shimmering fish of the lake cove, found in the daytime.
fish.cove-lantern: A glowing fish of the lake cove after dark.
fish.still-water-gar: A long-snouted gar that waits in the still cove waters in spring and summer.
fish.velvet-koi: A rare, deep-coloured koi that surfaces in the cove at dusk in autumn.
fish.hush: A rare fish of the cove that comes at dawn. It makes no splash at all.
fish.dusk-opal: A rare fish of the cove that gleams at dusk, whatever the season.
fish.deepglow: A rare, softly glowing fish of the cove on winter nights.
fish.shell-ghost: A rare fish of the cove that only appears when it rains.
fish.hearthwell-carp: A legend. An enormous carp, said to live in the lake cove. Catch it at dusk in autumn, in the rain.
fish.grandmother-hush: A legend. A huge old fish of the forest lake, kin to the cove's Hush. Catch it at dusk in spring, in the rain.
fish.valley-king: A legend. The king of the river. Catch it at dawn in autumn, in the rain.
fish.moonlit-mother: A legend. A pale giant char of the mountain lake. Catch it on a clear winter night.
fish.great-hearthfin: A legend. A huge sea fish, and the one legend that bites in any weather. Catch it by day in summer.
fish.fernscale: A rare fish of the woods pond that bites at dusk in every season. Only one can be caught.
